image_description: A close-up, front-facing view of a lionfish (Pterois) swimming in dark blue water. The fish displays characteristic vertical red/brown and white stripes on its body and large, fan-like pectoral fins with elongated rays. The dorsal spines are visible fanning out above the head. The background is blurred, suggesting an aquarium or reef environment.
